It's not just a game. It's a whole mood.

Some games bring out your competitive side. Some bring people together. Mahjong does both.

A game of strategy, observation, memory and a little bit of luck, Mahjong has been bringing people together for generations.

And now, it's getting a Watson's twist.

Welcome to Mahjong Madness, a social Mahjong experience at Watson's Vasanth Nagar, exclusively curated by Watson's Cantina.

Gather your people, pick your tiles and settle in for a game of Mahjong. Three rounds, plenty of friendly competition and a whole lot of fun.

No experience? No problem. Come curious, bring your friends and get playing.

Booking terms & cancellation policy.

  • A booking reserves one whole Mahjong table for a two-hour slot, for up to four players. The table fee is ₹1,000 per booking and includes three rounds.
  • Mahjong set rental is optional and charged separately at ₹500 per set. You are welcome to bring your own set.
  • Food and beverages are ordered separately from Watson's Vasanth Nagar and are charged separately.
  • Bookings are paid online. Your booking is confirmed only after the payment is verified.
  • Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before your scheduled booking. If your booking was paid online and is eligible for a refund, the refund is processed through the payment gateway.
  • For cancellations within 24 hours, please contact our booking team: Alka Nagpal +91 99801 36969 or Vedashree +91 98452 71738.
  • The experience is currently self-guided.
